docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,080.00 FILED BY EDWARDS, SHARLENA AS TO DEFENDANT TSAI, CHIA LIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-11-2018 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
ORDER RE: CONTINUED TO CURE UNTIMELY SERVICE. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-11-2018 - CONTINUED TO CURE UNTIMELY SERVICE TO DEC-19-2018 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SHARLENA EDWARDS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHIA LIN TSAI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHIA LIN TSAI REQUESTS A MANDARIN INTERPRETER. NO PROOF OF SERVICE WAS FILED. DEFENDANT RETAINS RIGHT TO BE SERVICED (DOES NOT WAIVE) PLAINTIFF STATED THAT DEFENDANT WAS SERVICED BUT SHE FAILED TO FILE. NO FURTHER SERVICE IS NECESSARY. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $0.00 - SERVED NOV-04-2018, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT TSAI, CHIA LIN

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-19-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-19-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF SHARLENE EDWARDS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHIA LIN TSAI IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY NON CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPRETER SHELDON YU. MR. YU WAS GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY COURT CLERK R.SAHATJIAN. DEFENDANT WAIVES BAD SERVICE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-19-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF EDWARDS, SHARLENA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TSAI, CHIA LIN $1,844.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,894.00, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF: $1644. PLUS $200 IN STATUTORY DAMAGES FOR BAD FAITH RETENTION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT. LANDLORDS MAY NOT RETAIN A DEPOSIT SOLELY BECAUSE TENANT DISAGREES WITH THE AMOUNT OF THE DEPOSIT.
